edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both statements are from the same Reuters article and state the same amount of bribes (over 148 million yuan). The origin is established via the metadata (same root_id and evidence_id), but since there are no specific phrases in the quotes themselves establishing the same origin, the source span is empty.

edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, Reuters reported “He accepted over 148 million yuan in money and assets in return, the court's first-instance judgement showed.”; on the same day, Reuters reported “and found that he illegally accepted over 148 million yuan ($22.05 million).”.

On 2026-09-08, Reuters reported “A Chinese court on Tuesday handed Jin Xiangjun, former governor of the coal-producing province of Shanxi, a death sentence with a two-year reprieve over corruption”; on the same day, Reuters reported “The suspended death sentence in Chinese law gives the accused a two-year reprieve from being executed, after which it is typically converted to life imprisonment.”.
